# OPENLANE launches refreshed mobile app to help car traders make the deal, wherever they are


** 17 Sep 2026


**Enhanced vehicle search, optimized mobile bidding using bid agent and Ultimo, direct negotiation and personalized notifications help professional car traders act on opportunities right from the OPENLANE app when they matter.**


Tienen, Belgium, 16 September 2026 —[OPENLANE Europe](https://www.openlane.eu/en/home) has launched a refreshed version of the OPENLANE mobile app, making it faster and easier for professional car traders to find the right vehicles, act on opportunities and make the deal wherever they are.


The refreshed app brings together the features that matter when a buying opportunity arises; from finding the right stock and placing or managing a bid to negotiating directly with the seller. Combined with personalized notifications, traders can react at the moments that matter without needing to be at their desks.


“Our customers’ business doesn’t stop when they leave their desks. The right vehicle can come up at any moment, and being able to act quickly can make the difference between winning or missing a deal. The refreshed OPENLANE app gives professional car traders the tools they need to act wherever they are,” said Grainne van Berkum, President of OPENLANE Europe.


## Everything you need to make the deal


The refreshed app introduces several enhancements designed to help professional car traders find opportunities, act quickly and turn them into successful deals:


- **Find the right vehicle faster** : Enhanced search functionality, similar-vehicle recommendations and a redesigned vehicle details page make it easier to discover relevant stock and quickly review the information that matters.
- **Bid wherever business takes you** : Customers can place and manage bids directly from their smartphone and use OPENLANE bidding tools including bid agent and Ultimo.
- **Negotiate to make the deal** : When the highest bid doesn’t immediately result in a deal, customers can negotiate directly with sellers from the app, helping both sides reach an agreement without having to return to a desktop.
- **Act when it matters** : Personalized notifications and timely alerts keep customers informed about bids, auction results, offers and negotiations, so they can take action at the optimal moment.
- **Choose your language** : The OPENLANE app is now available in 20 languages in total, adding Slovak, Finnish and Greek to make the mobile experience accessible to even more customers in their native language.
- **A faster, more personalized experience** : Improved speed and stability provide a smoother and more reliable experience, while settings including light and dark mode let customers adapt the app to their preferences.


## More ways to manage deals on mobile


OPENLANE plans to develop its mobile experience with post-sale functionality as the next area of focus. Future developments are expected to make it easier for customers to stay informed and manage the next steps after the deal has been made, directly from their smartphones.


The refreshed OPENLANE app is available in 20 languages and requires a valid OPENLANE account. It can be downloaded via[Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.carsontheweb&hl=en) and the[Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/openlane-eu/id1306619811) .


## About OPENLANE Europe


OPENLANE Europe, a business unit of global vehicle remarketing and technology solutions provider OPENLANE (NYSE: OPLN), makes used car wholesale easy for its customers so they can be successful. The company seamlessly connects OEMS, Fleet owners, wholesalers, and dealers with buyers in more than 50 countries across Europe. Its robust online car marketplace reduces risk, improves transparency and streamlines transactions. Headquartered in Belgium, OPENLANE Europe has sales operations in Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and the United Kingdom. For more information, visit[openlane.eu](https://www.openlane.eu/)


.
